caption: The drawing depicts a black metal object consisting of a rectangular grid made from parallel horizontal bars connected by two vertical bars at the sides and one at the middle. Attached to one side of the grid is a long, slightly curved handle with a simple loop at its end. In the center of the grid, there are two diagonal, crossed support bars that are joined by a small circular element, apparently serving as reinforcement or a pivot point. The grid is positioned at the center and right side of the image, while the handle extends toward the upper left corner of the composition. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present. The overall style is realistic and monochromatic, rendered in shades of black and gray.
title: Gridiron
